proposed_widenings.name: reduce_damage_taken
proposed_widenings.justification: The item's core mechanic is a reaction that subtracts a rolled amount plus an ability modifier from one incoming weapon hit's damage. That is neither resistance, immunity, temporary hit points, nor a roll modifier, so any current encoding would misstate the rule.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can take a Reaction to reduce the damage by 1d10 plus your Dexterity modifier

notes: ReactionTrigger.hit_by_attack_roll already supports the Ranged/Thrown weapon trigger for this item, but no existing effect atom can honestly encode one-shot damage reduction. The catch-the-missile rider is contingent on reducing the damage to 0 and is secondary to the missing core reduction effect.
